payload.purpose_context: This mission advances agent usage gauges, almost-done milestones and critical warnings (GitHub issue #38) on feat/issue-38-agent-gauges-warnings so stakeholders can track the work from mission creation onward.

options: Feasible core (transcript-based context %, almost-done, loop, stall; defer cost, 429, CPU, DND, sound)
payload.question: Issue #38 is large and only part of it has a real data source today. Which scope should this mission cover?

payload.final_answer: Feasible core (transcript-based context %, almost-done, loop, stall; defer cost, 429, CPU, DND, sound)

payload.question: Does the extracted Intent Summary and FR/NFR/C requirement set match what we should build for #38?

payload.final_answer: Confirm as-is (draft v2 after Fable review; Antigravity ask_question bug split out to issue #63)

options: AgentMonitorService evaluates; adapters only parse and emit readings
Adapters detect and emit finished warnings
payload.question: Where should warning policy (thresholds, stall timer, warning slot, toggles) live?

options: No - keep FR-010 literal (only same agent, Got it, or newer warning)
Yes - any needs-approval takes the bubble, warning stays active on the visor
payload.question: While agent A's warning is shown, may another agent's needs-approval replace the bubble?

payload.final_answer: AgentMonitorService evaluates; adapters only parse and emit readings (usage kind) plus fixed-threshold loop warnings
Yes - another agent's needs-approval takes the bubble; the warning stays active (amber visor) and its bubble returns once that approval is superseded (spec FR-010 amended)
